messages:
viv: Quick note 62 I'm landing a small docs PR to harmonize SDK snippets across Python/TS/Go for streaming + pagination + retries. Found a few subtle differences that trip customers (resume token name, partial-JSON handling). Drafting now.

noor: Sounds great. Can we standardize on a single opaque cursor name? My suggestion: `iter_cursor` to emphasize iteration/resume semantics. Add a clear line: 'do not parse `iter_cursor`'.

viv: Agreed. Plan: - Python: `async for` streaming with `resume_from=iter_cursor` example + reconnect/retry pattern. - TS: show both `for await` and `.getReader()` patterns, include a 2-line partial-JSON accumulator and a tiny retry helper. - Go: SSE-like `bufio.Scanner` loop + small backoff helper that accepts a closure. Also add migration notes and a backport checklist for archived quickstarts.

sam: For the TS retry helper, keep it micro (no deps). Example looks good: 

```ts
async function retriable<T>(fn: ()=>Promise<T>, tries=3){
  for(let i=0;i<tries;i++){
    try{ return await fn() }
    catch(e){ if(i===tries-1) throw e; await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r, 100*(i+1))) }
  }
}
```

cheng: For Python streaming, prefer showing how to preserve a `last_event_id` and pass it back as `resume_from`. Also show a reconnect example when encountering a transient network error. Keep snippets short.

viv: Example I'll add for Python: 

```py
last_event = None
async for part in client.chat.stream(prompt, resume_from=last_event):
    print(part.text)
    if hasattr(part, 'id'):
        last_event = part.id
# on transient error: reconnect with resume_from=last_event
```

noor: For TS partial JSON accumulation, include a comment that structured streaming is preferred when available. Example suggestion: 

```ts
let buf = ''
for await (const chunk of client.chat.stream({model, input})){
  buf += chunk.text
  try{ const obj = JSON.parse(buf); handle(obj); buf = '' } catch{ /* wait for more */ }
}
```

cheng: Go snippet: show scanner loop + a tiny `tryDo` backoff helper. Also demonstrate honoring context cancellation.

viv: I'll include short migration guidance: - `iter_cursor` is opaque; do not parse. - Legacy aliases: `cursor_token`, `page_token`. - If customers see missing items after migrating, recommend a short-time re-fetch by timestamp window or a background backfill; mention eventual consistency with edge caches. Also add a checklist to backport to v0.7/v0.8 quickstarts.

sam: Can you also add a short note about multipart streaming (metadata + token chunks) and the pattern to update resume cursor only after persisting metadata? That avoids duplication on reconnect.

viv: Good call, will add an example comment. I'll open the PR and request reviews from @noor and @cheng. Draft link will be posted here.

docs-bot: Draft PR created by viv: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3789  labels: docs, sdk-examples, migration

noor: I'll review once it's up. If acceptable, let's backport the snippets to the archived quickstarts before merging so customers referencing old pages don't break.

viv: Adding backport tasks to the PR checklist and a tiny changelog entry. Thanks all :sparkles:
